flow.title: How to change jobs in Japan
flow.lead: These are the steps for foreign residents in Japan who move to another company. Ask us anytime if anything is unclear.

steps.d: We ask about your visa, your job and your Japanese. It is free. We never tell your current company.
You have an interview with the company. Online interviews are possible.
The company decides to hire you. Check the working conditions carefully.
Documents are submitted to the Immigration Services Agency. The company or a support organization helps you.
Immigration gives permission. This can take some time.
You start working at the new company.

notes: Do not start working at the new company before you get permission. [Waiting for Imura's check]
Decide your last day at your current company together with the new company. A long period without work can cause problems. [Waiting for Imura's check]
If your visa expires soon, contact us early. [Waiting for Imura's check]
If the new job is in the same field, you may be able to move without an exam. If the field changes, you need to pass the exam for that field. [Waiting for Imura's check]
The rules can change. Please check the latest information with the Immigration Services Agency of Japan.
